purpose: Extend the eventual BR204 compact FULL178 certificate shape so the BR205 qBC gate can be decided without retaining raw states or rerunning BR204 merely to recover tail occupancy.
per_b_certificate_required_additions: qBC level-count histogram or equivalent exact commitment sufficient to recover counts for L<=8 and L>8
qBC-tail compact base-state count for L>8
qBC-tail compact population multiplicity for L>8
qBC-tail retained evaluation-cell count after the BR204 routing/support/capacity filters
qBC-tail retained multiplicity after the same filters
BR202 K8 objective contribution restricted to L>8
deterministic qBC-tail attribution digest bound to b and the existing source-lock manifest
per_b_invariants: all qBC-tail fields are computed in the same streamed b unit before raw state data are discarded
L<=8 and L>8 partition the compact BC base states exactly
all L<=8 states use exact qBC levels under K8 and therefore have zero K8-vs-FULL truncation slack by construction
the addendum must not cause a second BR204 population traversal when the fields can be accumulated in the existing pass
shard_summary_required_additions: sum BR202 K8 objective contribution restricted to L>8
ordered commitment to all member-b qBC-tail attribution digests
union_verifier_required_additions: qBC-tail fields sum exactly from 97 b units through eight shards to the parent manifest
L<=8 plus L>8 compact partition agrees with the BR204 compact population census
qBC-tail retained multiplicity is nonnegative and source-locked
BR202 K8 objective contribution restricted to L>8 is nonnegative and source-locked
formal BR205 tail-activity half-gate is true only if exact FULL178 qBC-tail retained multiplicity is positive and exact FULL178 K8 tail objective contribution is positive
bounded strict-improvement evidence remains a separate prerequisite and is never extrapolated numerically to FULL178

BR205_gate_semantics.bounded_half: PASS_PREPARATORY_EVIDENCE: deeper qBC strictly improves the identical bounded population and all bounded K8-vs-FULL slack is localized to L>8
BR205_gate_semantics.full178_half: PENDING_BR204_HEAVY: exact compact BR204 certificate must show positive L>8 retained mass and positive K8 tail objective contribution

execution.storage_rule: use compact integer counters/digests only; remain under existing per-b/shard/parent hard caps
